generalfeedback.text:
Ask two questions about each rule: is it about a distance or an angle, and is the distance measured from a point or from a line?

  • The same distance from two points A and B: the perpendicular bisector of AB.

  • A fixed distance from one point A: a circle with centre A.

  • A fixed distance from a straight line l: a pair of lines parallel to l, one on each side.

  • The same distance from two straight lines that meet: the bisectors of the angles between them.

  • A fixed angle at which AB is seen: arcs of circles through A and B.

questiondescription.text:
Loci: loci in words and in construction language

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.3: Relate the language of loci to the language of constructions.

Core

This question is original to this project.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).
